en.html:
When two warriors who know the manners of war meet in single combat, their exhaust draws a figure eight—twin wheels—in the sky. Hence Futawagakari: Twin-Wheel Engagement. Even for killing, the proper form is there.

The closer the tsurugi in performance, the closer the pilots in skill, the more perfect and beautiful those twin wheels become. A pity about the exhibition arrangements. However beautifully drawn, the art lasts only an instant; even the artists cannot stay to see the whole thing.

en.html:
I sent that murmur after the silhouette as it pitched badly out of position and began flying all over the place.
The wielder killed for pleasure. The tsurugi had the same taste. Such a matching pair, these two: drawn together, and apparently fused at last into Aoe. Whether either mind had registered my words, I could not say.

Their superb armour-steel had kept the blow from being fatal. But their fighting power should be nearly finished.
One more stroke ought to stop the enemy craft—the sixth parasite, the sixth soldier ant.

This time also, a close thing. Still, it seemed we could just prevent the egg from hatching.

ja.text:
青江《ははははははは！
　何が見えた!?　何が見えたァ！》青江《それは貴様の安らぎ・・・だ!!
　地獄の冷たさには耐えられようと――その
温かさには抗えまい!?》青江《沈め！
　安らぎの夢に沈んでしまえぇぇェェェ!!》村正《御堂――――!!》
